AppointmentListFilter.title: AppointmentListFilter
AppointmentListFilter.description:
List Appointments. Server-owned filter facets so the FE never re-derives
time math. tz-bound facets (today/this_week) derive boundaries from the
requesting user's users.timezone.
  upcoming    — status in {SCHEDULED,CONFIRMED} and end > now
  past        — end <= now or status in {COMPLETED,CANCELLED,NO_SHOW}
  all         — no filter
  today       — start within the viewer's calendar day
  next_hour   — start in (now, now+1h] and status live
  next_24h    — start in (now, now+24h] and status live
  this_week   — start within the viewer's calendar week (Mon–Sun)
  in_progress — status = IN_PROGRESS (doctor-only unpaid-hold view)
